games.context: Philadelphia (12-3) lead the East and visit Orlando (6-7). The 76ers are without Jaylen Brown (hamstring), and Joel Embiid is day-to-day with a foot injury. Orlando are missing Paolo Banchero (high-ankle sprain), Jonathan Isaac (knee) and Noah Penda (hamstring). Despite the gap in the standings, the market makes Philadelphia only a short road favourite (-122 at DraftKings), with the total at 223.5.

games.venue: Spyros Kyprianou Arena, Limassol (Maccabi's EuroLeague home this season)
games.context: Dubai (8-4), one game behind leaders Valencia and Olympiacos (9-3), visit Maccabi (3-9), who play their EuroLeague home games in Limassol, Cyprus this season. Maccabi lost 97-95 in overtime to Olympiacos in Round 12; Dubai beat Anadolu Efes 80-75 behind Mfiondu Kabengele's 18 points and 18 rebounds. Maccabi are without Iffe Lundberg (quadriceps tendon), and Dubai's Mam Jaiteh (Achilles) is doubtful.

news.text: Iffe Lundberg is out (partial quadriceps tendon tear, suffered in practice in October). Basketnews says he will have surgery and is not expected back before February. He averaged 7.7 points in six EuroLeague games.
news.src: Eurodevotion (official Round 13 report), 19 Nov; Basketnews injury tracker; Eurohoops 20 Oct

news.text: Oshae Brissett (back) is cleared. Kamar Baldwin joined from Bayern on 10 Nov. Keaton Wallace (18) and Jimmy Clark (15) led Maccabi in the 97-95 overtime loss to Olympiacos in Limassol.
news.src: BasketballSphere injuries; Eurohoops Round 12 report and roundup

news.text: Mam Jaiteh is doubtful (Achilles rehab), the only Dubai name in the official Round 13 report as Eurodevotion summarises it.

Basketnews (18 Nov) and BasketballSphere (17 Nov) also list Davis Bertans (hamstring, missed Rounds 10-12, out indefinitely) and Kosta Kondic (hip, missed Rounds 10-12) as out. Both are bench players (3.3 and 2.7 points). Justin Anderson (hamstring) has not played a EuroLeague game this season. Thomas Walkup is cleared.
Round 12: Dubai beat Efes 80-75; Kabengele had 18 points and 18 rebounds, Musa 14 points and 7 assists, Bacon 13.

news.text: Round 12: Zalgiris beat Bayern 117-114 in overtime. Carsen Edwards scored 32, including the last five points of regulation and eight in overtime; Tubelis and Valanciunas had 15 each.

games.context: Bayern (3-9) are still looking for their first EuroLeague home win and lost 117-114 in overtime at Zalgiris in Round 12, despite 33 points from Johannes Thiemann. Baskonia (1-11) are last and lost 85-82 at home to Hapoel after leading 71-64 going into the fourth quarter. Bayern are without captain Vladimir Lucic; Baskonia are without Kenneth Faried, and Tadas Sedekerskis and Marcio Santos are doubtful.

games.context: Valencia (9-3) top the table with Olympiacos and won 76-64 at Partizan in Round 12, their sixth straight win in all competitions. Virtus (5-7) beat Panathinaikos 84-79 to end a five-game losing run but are 2-4 away from home. Valencia are without Nate Reuvers (foot), and Nikola Mirotic (adductor, out since Round 8) is a doubt; Virtus are missing only Davide Casarin.

news.text: Mirotic's status conflicts between sources. Eurodevotion's summary of the official Round 13 report (06:00 UTC, before the odds) lists him out (groin/adductor). Valencia's own preview (18 Nov) has him back on the active roster and gradually returning to team practice, and Europa Press reports that he is back. He has missed Rounds 9-12 and averages 13.0 points in 16.5 minutes off the bench. If he plays, that is a plus for Valencia, not a reason for an adjust.
news.src: Eurodevotion 19 Nov; Valencia Basket preview 18 Nov; Europa Press via Diario Siglo XXI 18 Nov

news.text: Nate Reuvers is out (foot bone injury; last played Round 7). Valencia are top with Olympiacos at 9-3 after winning 76-64 at Partizan (Brooks and Taylor 15 each, Shorts 12).
news.src: Eurodevotion (official Round 13 report); Valencia Basket preview; Eurohoops Round 12 roundup

news.text: Davide Casarin is out (tibial plateau fracture/bone bruise, about eight weeks). Bobi Klintman has recovered from flu, and the rest of the squad is available.
news.src: Eurodevotion (official Round 13 report), 19 Nov; Basketnews injury tracker

news.text: Round 12: Virtus beat Panathinaikos 84-79 at home; Aliou Diarra had 15 points and 9 rebounds, Mouhamet Diouf 15 and 7. Virtus have lost their last two road games, at Hapoel and Efes, and their last three EuroLeague visits to Valencia.
news.src: Eurohoops Round 12 roundup; Europa Press via Diario Siglo XXI
